package.name: Chat
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Private messaging with paired devices; this device keeps its own history and offline queue.

capabilities.chat.use: Send and receive chat messages, attachments, reactions, and receipts with this paired device. Changing or clearing your copies is separately opt-in.

exports.description: Exchanges chat operations between paired devices.

receive.description: Receive bounded chat operations from an authenticated paired device.

view.description: Show conversations and handle this page's own events.

settings.label: Add Chat to navigation
settings.help: Show Chat as a separate page. You can always open it from this extension’s settings.

settings.label: Allow this device to delete its sent messages here
settings.help: A request can replace this device’s own messages here with a deletion marker. Off keeps your copies.

settings.label: Allow this device to request clearing shared history
settings.help: A request can remove copies of messages this device already shared with you. This does not remove newer or unsent messages.

pages.title: Apache License 2.0
pages.explains: You may use, copy, change and share this extension under Apache-2.0. Keep its licence and notices with copies you share.
pages.changes: Accepting this agreement grants no permission to your devices or files.

pages.title: Messages stay on the participating devices
pages.explains: Chat keeps local copies of messages and chosen attachments, and queues sends until a paired recipient is reachable. Group recipients see the group title and member labels.
pages.changes: Each recipient keeps its own copy. Remote deletion and clear requests are optional and may be declined. Exported copies are outside Chat's control.
